scope: Independent exact-integer derivation for the hash-pinned Level-I 492-bit shift/subtract recurrence. This checks the mathematical source recurrence and reduced/full-width executable models; it is not a formal C/assembly proof, a whole-Sign constant-time proof, or physical side-channel evidence.

literature_context.sqisign_countermeasure: David Jacquemin, Anisha Mukherjee, Peter Kutas, and Sujoy Sinha Roy, Ready to SQI? Safety First!, Cryptology ePrint 2023/807, Algorithm 8 and Theorem 4
literature_context.generic_iteration_source: Daniel J. Bernstein and Bo-Yin Yang, Fast constant-time gcd computation and modular inversion, Theorem 11.2
literature_context.distinction: The scheduled floor((49*k+57)/17) count comes from the Bernstein-Yang divstep bound. The independent proof below does not assume that divstep theorem applies to Algorithm 8; it proves a stronger sufficient bound directly for the frozen shift/subtract recurrence.

source_to_model_mapping.state: a,b are nonnegative magnitudes; every active round sorts them as maximum>=minimum
source_to_model_mapping.freeze: active is minimum>=ceil(sqrt(original modulus)); inactive rounds retain a,b by conditional move
source_to_model_mapping.publication: after all scheduled rounds, publish min(a,b) only if it is below the threshold
source_to_model_mapping.euclid_equivalence: The selected power-of-two multiplier never exceeds floor(maximum/minimum). If next<minimum, it is therefore the exact Euclidean remainder; the first next below the threshold is the same remainder returned by the legacy division loop.

proof.one_round_lemma: For every active state, S_next <= (10/17)*S. For alpha=0 this factors as 24*(r-1/4)*(7/6-r)>=0. For alpha>=1, x=2^alpha*r lies in (1/4,1), r^2<=x^2/4, and the remaining concave quadratic is positive at both interval endpoints.
proof.threshold_lemma: An active state has min(a,b)>=ceil(sqrt(M)), hence S>=M. Initially S<2*M^2 and M<2^492.

model_validation.role: Regression and source/model cross-check only; the all-input guarantee comes from the exact contraction proof, not these samples.
